rows.name: Kill adds the right reward
rows.setup: Game.money = 3500; Game.buy(ak47); Game.money = 800; spawn watcher 15 m ahead with AI disabled
steps: aim_at(watcher, body) + fire() until dead; record kill_reward
Game.money = 800; spawn grazer; equip knife; aim_at + fire until dead
Game.money = economy.max_money - 100; spawn watcher; kill with ak47
pass_criteria: case 1: money == 800 + round(ak47.kill_award * economy.kill_award_factor * watcher.kill_reward_mult) (= 1100)
case 2: money == 800 + round(knife.kill_award * factor * grazer.kill_reward_mult) (= 3050)
case 3: money == economy.max_money (16000)
kill_reward signal amount equals each delta

rows.name: Buying subtracts the price
rows.setup: Game.money = p250 + ak47 + hegrenade + kevlar prices (setup); no machine alerted; Game.buy() is never called
steps: simulated input only (Input.parse_input_event, keys from the game's InputMap): buy key -> mouse to the item's slot as drawn on screen (displayed name + $price) -> left click

each case: money -= resolved price; the item is in the inventory (Kevlar: armor == kevlar.armor_points)

rows.name: Weak spot deals more than body
rows.setup: equip glock; spawn watcher A and B 10 m ahead, AI disabled, full health and armor
steps: aim_at(A, body); fire()
aim_at(B, eye); fire()
strider and grazer: weak_spots() not empty
pass_criteria: weak damage > body damage
weak damage == glock.damage * glock.headshot_mult * falloff (= 120 at 0 m, ~105.6 at 10 m)
body damage == glock.damage * glock.armor_ratio * combat.armor_ratio_scale * falloff (= 14.1 at 0 m, ~12.4 at 10 m) while armor > 0
falloff = range_modifier ^ (distance_u / combat.range_step_u), distance from fire().point/.distance (else camera to machine +-1.5 m)
each machine loses exactly the reported damage
every machine type reports >= 1 weak spot, including its sheet weak_spot_parts

rows.name: New machines: suspicious -> alert -> attack (Sawtooth, Scrapper, Broadhead)
rows.setup: for each of sawtooth, scrapper, broadhead: player at 35 m (Sawtooth 45 m) on open ground in a real cell, machine spawned with AI on, player.invulnerable; all behaviour through lib/inputsim.gd (Input.parse_input_event); Game API only for setup and reading state

stand in view; if no alert after 10 s fire one glock shot into the air (mouse button input)
log machine_state_changed for 30 s per machine
pass_criteria: states contain (idle|patrol|graze|scavenge) -> suspicious -> alert -> attack for all three (none of them flees: sheet flee_on_alert false)
sawtooth: an attack of kind charge (pounce or charge) starts within 30 s
scrapper: a laser_burst projectile is spawned within 30 s
broadhead: a charge starts within 30 s and a second Broadhead of the herd also leaves graze (defend)
details list per machine the times of each state
needs_api: states stalk and scavenge accepted as sub-states of suspicious/graze

rows.name: Weak spot beats body for all 6 machines, real shots, 8 directions
rows.setup: for each of the 6 machines: AI off, spawned on flat ground; player with deagle (accurate first shot) teleported to 8 positions on a 10 m ring (0, 45 ... 315 deg) around it; all behaviour through lib/inputsim.gd (Input.parse_input_event); Game API only for setup and reading state
steps: at each position aim with mouse-motion input at every weak point (oracle gives the target angle, inputsim moves the mouse)
before firing raycast camera -> weak point: the first collider hit must be the weak spot (else the direction counts as blocked)
fire with the mouse button; retry up to 3 shots on a spread miss; reset machine health between shots
fire one body shot from the same position for comparison
pass_criteria: every machine: >= 1 direction where the weak spot is the first hit and weak damage > body damage
weak damage == deagle.damage * deagle.headshot_mult * falloff (weak spots ignore armor)
details: per machine the number of directions out of 8 where the weak spot is hittable first, and which weak point

rows.name: Performance: start + 10-cell route
rows.setup: child process (clean VRAM state), vsync off, window perf.resolution, warm cache; all behaviour through lib/inputsim.gd (Input.parse_input_event); Game API only for setup and reading state
steps: after world_ready + 3x3 + perf.settle_s: read VRAM; slow 360 deg turn with mouse-motion input for perf.start_measure_s, record every frame time
walk perf.route_cells at run speed (knife out) with held W and mouse steering; if stuck > 5 s, jump (input), after 15 s teleport to the next waypoint and count it
record frame times, cell-insertion windows (Game.cell_loaded and insertion start) and VRAM to <out>/t15/frametimes.csv
pass_criteria: VRAM at start <= perf.vram_start_max_mb
start and route: average fps >= 60 and 1 % low >= 45
no frame > perf.max_load_frame_ms while a cell is inserting
route visited >= 10 distinct cells; teleport fallbacks <= 2
